subject: Stepwise conversion & capacity onramp discussion
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@finlytics.com
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: stepwise conversion & capacity onramp

Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks for the call last week. I wanted to capture FinLytics' high-level ask so we can make progress toward an amendment:

- We're looking to convert our 12‑month usage arrangement into a multi‑year commit with a stepwise onramp (we prefer a 3yr structure).
- Year 1 would be a conservative commit (~50% of our current run rate) while we onboard more features; Year 2/3 scale to 100%/150%.
- Important: procurement prefers an auto‑renew opt‑in but with a 90‑day out clause and co‑terming to our fiscal year (Dec 31).
- We also want the option to add burst capacity for Q4 data processing at a pre‑agreed uplift rate.

I've attached our Q2 usage report so you can suggest sizing for the stepwise commits. Procurement (cc'd) will need an invoice cadence and sample amendment language to review legal.

Appreciate a short proposal with (a) term lengths and phasing, (b) pricing tiers for the step increases, and (c) a simple DocuSign path we can send to our legal team.

Best,
Elena
--
Elena Soto
Head of Data & ML Engineering, FinLytics
elena@finlytics.com
Attachment: usage_report_Q2.csv
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: stepwise conversion & capacity onramp

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the Q2 data.

We can definitely structure a 3yr conversion with a gradual commit ramp. Quick notes from my side:

- Proposal we typically run: Year1 = 50% baseline commit (discounted), Year2 = 100% (standard commit), Year3 = 150% (volume pricing applied).
- Auto‑renew can be included with your 90‑day opt‑out; we'll show both an auto‑renew and a fixed‑end option in the amendment so legal can choose.
- Burst capacity: we can pre‑price a Q4 burst bucket (pre‑allocated tokens) and an overage runway with a fixed per‑token uplift — useful for predictable planning.

Marissa will draft an SOW + amendment language (I'll ask her to include a clear billing cadence option: quarterly in arrears vs. annual prepay). Kimberly will own the commercial terms and DocuSign flow.

Could you confirm target token/day for the onramp (approximate) and whether FinLytics needs a regional data residency addendum?

I'll have an internal draft to you by EOD Thu.

Thanks,
Marcus
--
Marcus Lin
Director, Accounts — Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-03T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: FinLytics — draft SOW & stepwise amendment (v2)

Elena — attaching a first draft SOW and amendment text (FinLytics_SOW_v2.pdf). Highlights in the doc:

1) Term & structure
   - 36 month master amendment. Effective date = 2028-08-01.
   - Co‑term to FinLytics fiscal year end (Dec 31).

2) Commit phasing and pricing
   - Year 1: 50% of baseline run rate, unit price = $0.0009/token (10% discount vs standard).
   - Year 2: 100% baseline, unit price = $0.0008/token.
   - Year 3: 150% baseline, unit price = $0.0007/token + overage banding.

3) Burst capacity addendum
   - Pre‑purchased burst bucket for Q4 (up to 25M tokens) at a fixed uplift of +25% of contracted unit price.

4) Auto‑renew & termination
   - Default = auto‑renew for 12 months unless either party provides written 90‑day notice prior to renewal.

5) Billing & invoicing
   - Default cadence: quarterly in arrears; option to switch to annual prepay with an additional 3% service credit applied.

We left placeholders for token/day onramp numbers — Marcus flagged that so procurement can confirm sizing. If you want, we can show an alternate that frontloads more capacity in Year 1 for an additional credit.

Next steps: Elena/procure to confirm token estimates and preferred billing cadence. Once confirmed, Kimberly will finalize commercial tables and push to DocuSign.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Renewals & Renewals Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: FinLytics_SOW_v2.pdf
From: Elena Soto <elena@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@finlytics.com
Date: 2028-07-05T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLytics — draft SOW & stepwise amendment (v2)

Thanks Marissa — the SOW looks good at a high level. A couple of procurement asks so we can move internally:

- Invoice cadence: prefer quarterly in arrears; procurement will sign off if the amendment includes a mid‑year true‑up clause.
- Can you confirm contract language for data residency? We operate primarily in US but may require EU residency later.
- Please include a sample DocuSign package and the expected timeline from signature to production rollout (we'd like <= 10 business days for baseline onboarding).

procure@finlytics.com is fine to receive the DocuSign link. I'll work on internal token/day estimates and reply by Monday with numbers.

Elena
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-06T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final amendment summary & DocuSign package (action: signature)

Elena / Team — following your asks, we've produced a condensed amendment and DocuSign package. Summary (key commercial terms):

- Term: 36 months (2028-08-01 to 2031-07-31) co‑terminating to FinLytics fiscal year (Dec 31).
- Commit phasing: Year1 = 50% baseline, Year2 = 100% baseline, Year3 = 150% baseline.
- Pricing: tiered unit prices embedded in SOW (see attached tables); burst bucket for Q4 = up to 25M tokens at +25% uplift.
- Auto‑renew: enabled by default; 90‑day written opt‑out before renewal window.
- Billing: quarterly in arrears (default). Mid‑year true‑up clause included. Option to prepay annually for a 3% service credit.
- Data residency: US by default; addendum for EU residency available as an add‑on (timelines/costs noted in schedule B).
- Onboarding timeline: baseline production access within 10 business days post‑signature; burst capacity provisioning within 5 business days of request (subject to quota).

Action items for FinLytics:
1) Confirm token/day estimates (reply to this thread).
2) Procurement to confirm billing cadence (we default to quarterly in arrears).
3) Click the DocuSign link to review and sign: https://app.docusign.com/some-signature-id

Once signed, we'll create the amendment (DL-2028-0621-FIN) and schedule an onboarding kickoff with Solutions.

Thanks — Kim
--
Kimberly Park
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
